name: kube-verdict
description: Anchor-by-render root-cause analysis for Kubernetes incidents — compares what Git declares, what Helm applied and the live cluster, and turns each drift into a ranked structured diagnosis; an LLM, when configured, explains it and proposes remediation with a rollback plan. Local inference via Ollama by default; a remote provider receives the prompt.

interface.shortDescription: GitOps-aware Kubernetes incident RCA: render-vs-live drift → ranked diagnosis + remediation
interface.longDescription: KubeVerdict compares what Git declares, what Helm applied and the live cluster, and turns each drift into a ranked structured diagnosis before any LLM explanation; the LLM explains it and proposes remediation commands with a rollback plan, and the run stops at a human approval gate. Local inference via Ollama by default; a remote provider receives the prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Investigate crashlooping or OOMKilled pods in a namespace and propose a safe remediation
